class.name: LRTExportPlugin
class.brief_description: Prepares and packs LRT geometry dependencies.
class.description: Packs saved LRT build data and its geometry and material dependencies without instantiating scenes or using a rendering device. Rebuild LRT and save each scene before exporting, including headless exports. Dynamic inputs without a stable field identity export their prepared resource dependencies and rebuild the field at runtime. Missing or outdated build data is reported as an export error.

method.name: collect_export_dependencies
method.description: Validates the saved scene's LRT cache manifests and returns [code]ok[/code], [code]count[/code], and [code]assets[/code], or an [code]error[/code]. Supports inherited and instanced scenes without executing their scripts.

method.name: prepare_resource
method.description: Prepares geometry dependencies of a resource without modifying it. Returns [code]ok[/code], [code]count[/code], and [code]assets[/code], or an [code]error[/code].
